text: そんな　こと　いわないで　また　あいて　してくれよお

structure.jp: そんな　こと　いわないで
また　あいて　してくれよお
structure.en: come on, be my opponent again

patterns.name: 〜ないで
patterns.explanation: ないで on a verb asks someone not to do it, and leads on to what they should do instead. いわないで = 'don't say that, and'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: てくれる after a verb means someone does it as a favor to the speaker. くれ is the blunt asking form used between boys and men. あいて　してくれ = 'be my opponent, will you'.
